_comment: Snapshot of device B (the cloud copy when device A syncs). Differs from device A so that every merge rule fires once: a duplicate history entry (q-002), an undated legacy entry (q-009), a bookmark removed on A but present on B (q-001), a word deleted on A but present on B (Median), a newer word on B (Ratio), a stamped preference (prefs 2500 vs none), a later settings stamp on A (5000 vs 4000), a note clash (q-001), and a higher milestone level on B.
